chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 106: Ji Ning Passes the War God Hall & Enters the Treasure Vault
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning passes the War God Hall’s first level, fails the second in seconds, and gains access to a legendary treasure trove filled with top-grade Mortal-ranked items.
og_title: War God Hall: Ji Ning’s First Real Loot Drop
og_description: Ji Ning passes his trial and enters a vault full of game-changing treasures—formations, swords, and more.
twitter_title: He passed the first level, but barely survived 10 seconds in the second! What’s in the vault?
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s trial leads to a legendary loot table: from the Nine Yang Sword Formation to a clan-protecting formation.
